title: Transcript and challenge specification
requirement: The qualified backend SHALL specify canonical transcript absorption order, domain tags, encodings, cross-field/limb conversion and challenge derivation, including verifier identity and recursive messages; circuit and native verifiers SHALL implement that same contract.
tests: Compatible vectors agree; changed index digest, omitted challenge commitment, ambiguous encoding, invalid limbs and semantically changed parent ordering reject.

title: Deferred obligations, base cases and active masks
requirement: The interface SHALL identify each deferred obligation, authenticated inputs, producer, consumer and connecting invariant; final acceptance SHALL discharge every active obligation. Branch choice, predecessor cardinality, padding and base-case masks SHALL be constrained by the authorized relation.
tests: Valid base and two-parent continuation pass. Changed deferred scalar/sponge, disabled required finalizer, empty required batch, recursive case relabeled base and dummy promoted to parent reject.

title: Heterogeneous compatibility and key authorization
requirement: Each side-loaded relation SHALL bind statement schema, field order/encoding, child recursive shape, supported features, domains/chunks/rounds, key and parameter identity. Key data-to-identity integrity and identity-to-owner/program authorization SHALL both hold.
tests: Compatible authorized heterogeneous relations pass; same-shaped trivial relation, misleading key hash, unauthorized key-root update, incompatible feature/field count and oversized domain reject. Distinguish child shape, direct fan-in and total ancestry.

title: Verified values and auxiliary output
requirement: Tooling SHALL distinguish parsed proof data, cryptographically verified statements, witness-only or auxiliary values, predicted effects and authenticated actual effects. Every mandatory effect/history dependency SHALL be constrained and verified; current-state settlement SHALL include authoritative preconditions.
tests: Invalid predecessor with consistent public fields, omitted verify call, altered auxiliary fee/recipient and valid stale-state proof cannot authorize effects. A verified permitted successor bound to current state passes.

title: Production proof-mode separation
requirement: Evidence collection and deployed acceptance SHALL assert real proving and complete verification configuration; simulation, dummy proofs, disabled-proof mode and empty test keys SHALL be visibly distinct and SHALL NOT qualify production acceptance.
tests: A local test-mode success with dummy proof fails an independent real verifier; mode toggles and mock ledger paths cannot yield a final-valid evidence record.
evidence: Developer D07; historical Midnight build-mode observations.

title: Parameter and cache provenance
requirement: Cache and parameter artifacts SHALL bind content digests, semantic/build tuple, purpose and expected identity. Batch parameters SHALL have a common authenticated identity or a proved compatibility relation; equal dimensions alone SHALL NOT establish compatibility.
tests: Cold/warm builds preserve qualified semantics; stale/corrupt/relabeled cache entries reject or safely rebuild. Equal-length incompatible parameters reject or use an explicitly sound separate verification path.
evidence: M07; developer D08; no exploit claim from inspected TODO.

title: Batching and join soundness
requirement: Batching SHALL specify coefficient/challenge generation, full-batch binding, randomness assumptions, required cardinality and composed soundness error. Any bounded-fan-in tree decomposition SHALL preserve authorized parent coverage, duties and budgets.
tests: A batch with one invalid member fails under its stated security guarantee; empty required batches, omitted member and adversarial cancellation/coefficient attempts fail. Binary-tree and permitted direct joins preserve the same financial relation; harmless shared ancestry is not duplicated spending.
evidence: M07/M08; developer D05. Tests do not replace probabilistic soundness arguments.

title: Specification and component assurance coverage
requirement: The qualification dossier SHALL trace mathematical statement, specification, compiler constraint and final verifier code for every used feature, and record exact audit/theorem scope and gaps for dependencies, custom gates, lookups, bindings and recursion.
tests: A historical recursion-layer audit cannot qualify an unaudited gate or changed tuple. A complete supported-feature matrix names evidence or an open obligation for every component; documentation/code disagreement remains unresolved until reconciled.
evidence: 2023 Pickles audit physical pp3/5/6/7/8; present study is not a new audit.
